posts.title: Be a better listener by picking the right distractions
posts.description: At a recent Boulder Ruby meetup, we talked about our struggles with paying attention during remote meetings, especially after several in a row. My approach raised a few eyebrows: I actively try to distract myself during meetings! It’s the only way I can pay attention: the key is finding the right distractions.
